audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[N].side is "Skill" on all seven rows, but content win[0..6] all read "Tristana" and every whys[N] explicitly argues Tristana wins that stage.
audit.why: The content layer is internally consistent and kit-grounded (Ziggs is immobile with only a self-knockback escape, and Tristana's range/burst/W-jump answer his poke at every stage through 2+ items), so the full-layer blanket-Skill chart is the stale half.
audit.corrected: Set phases[0..6].side all to "Tristana" to match win[0..6] and their whys.

audit.why: Level 2 all-in, level 6 escaping his ult/diving on self-knock cooldown, and first-item burst window before his poke matters are correctly named and kit-grounded.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Satchel Charge and W Rocket Jump but with no actual cooldown numbers, and the matchup never mentions the two missingInteractions flags: Satchel Charge's percent-health blast bypasses stacked resistances, and Short Fuse (P) is an auto-reset burst tell.
audit.why: Satchel Charge is 20/18/16/14/12s; its percentHealth flag means stacking armour alone does not answer it, so damage items matter more than pure resistances. Ziggs's P resets/empowers his next auto after any ability cast, the tell before his real damage lands.
audit.corrected: Added real cooldowns, the percent-health/resistances note, and the Short Fuse reset-tell to breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.before: E the bomb, stack two autos, and step back at three — the threat does the zoning and the fourth stack stays loaded.
edits.after: Four stacks detonate the bomb: commit at four or peel at three — the gap between eats a free Minefield slow tick.

edits.before: Jumping in with the bomb unstacked and R down — Tristana without the string is a yordle tourist at a gunfight.
edits.after: R punishes the whiff, not just kills — knock him off Satchel range before he resets, then close with your reset.

edits.before: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — His knockback escape — and your tower’s execution clause; he is catchable while it is down. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Rocket Jump (reset) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Satchel Charge (20/18/16/14/12s) is his knockback escape and turret-execute — he's catchable only while it's down. - Its percent-health blast punishes stacked armour; itemize damage, not just resistances. - His P auto-resets after any ability, the tell before real burst.
